lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Ask the server what, which, how, where and how much about dishes, wine and the restaurant.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Ask the server what they recommend, how a dish is prepared, and how much a bottle of wine costs.
lessons.title: Ask About the Menu and the Price
lessons.objective: Ask a server what they recommend, how a dish is prepared, and how much a bottle costs.
lessons.focus: Use qu'est-ce que for “what,” quel or quelle before a noun for “which,” comment for “how,” où for “where,” and combien for “how much.” In a polite restaurant question, you can also use est-ce que before the subject and verb.
lessons.scene: Sam asks Camille about the daily dish, the fish preparation, and a bottle of wine.

cards.en: How much does this bottle cost?
How do you prepare the fish?

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Qu'est-ce que vous recommandez ce soir ?
reader.en: What do you recommend tonight?

reader.speaker: Camille
reader.fr: Le plat du jour est le poisson.
reader.en: The dish of the day is the fish.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Comment préparez-vous le poisson ?
reader.en: How do you prepare the fish?

reader.speaker: Camille
reader.fr: Nous le faisons griller avec des légumes.
reader.en: We grill it with vegetables.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Quelle est la spécialité locale ?
reader.en: What is the local specialty?

reader.speaker: Camille
reader.fr: C'est le gratin de la maison.
reader.en: It's the house gratin.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Combien coûte cette bouteille de vin ?
reader.en: How much does this bottle of wine cost?

reader.speaker: Camille
reader.fr: Elle coûte trente euros. Où voulez-vous vous asseoir ?
reader.en: It costs thirty euros. Where would you like to sit?

speaking.goal: Ask what the server recommends, how the fish is prepared, and how much a bottle of wine costs.
speaking.closure: Je vous laisse regarder la carte.

lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Say not yet, nothing more, another one, more or less while ordering and finishing dinner.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Tell the server you are not ready yet, then ask for another drink and say you want nothing more after dessert.
lessons.title: Not Yet, Another Glass, and Nothing More
lessons.objective: Say you are not ready yet, ask for another drink, request less spice, and finish an order.
lessons.focus: Use ne ... pas encore for “not yet,” ne ... rien for “nothing,” ne ... jamais for “never,” and ne ... personne for “nobody.” Encore can mean “another/more” in a request; moins means “less.” Keep the two parts of each negative around the verb in careful speech.
lessons.scene: Sam needs more time, orders another drink, and closes the meal after dessert.

cards.note: With ne ... personne, this means nobody; une personne means a person.
In encore un verre, it means another glass.

cards.fr: Nous ne voulons rien d'autre, merci.
cards.en: We don't want anything else, thank you.

cards.fr: Encore un verre de vin blanc, s'il vous plaît.
cards.en: Another glass of white wine, please.

reader.speaker: Camille
reader.fr: Vous êtes prêts à commander ?
reader.en: Are you ready to order?

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Pas encore, merci. Nous regardons la carte.
reader.en: Not yet, thank you. We're looking at the menu.

reader.speaker: Camille
reader.fr: Vous souhaitez encore quelque chose à boire ?
reader.en: Would you like anything else to drink?

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Encore un verre de vin blanc, s'il vous plaît.
reader.en: Another glass of white wine, please.

reader.speaker: Léa
reader.fr: Pour moi, de l'eau. Je ne bois jamais d'alcool.
reader.en: Water for me. I never drink alcohol.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Et le plat, moins épicé, s'il vous plaît.
reader.en: And the dish, less spicy, please.

reader.speaker: Camille
reader.fr: Bien sûr. Après le dessert, vous désirez autre chose ?
reader.en: Of course. After dessert, would you like anything else?

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Nous ne voulons rien d'autre, merci.
reader.en: We don't want anything else, thank you.

lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Ask the server politely for the check, a photo and items at the table.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Ask the server politely for a glass of water and the check, and ask if you can pay by card.
lessons.title: Polite Requests at the Table
lessons.objective: Politely ask a server for water, the bill, a photo, and table items, then ask to pay by card.
lessons.focus: Pourriez-vous ... ? is a polite request. With vous, a direct instruction uses the -ez form: apportez, attendez, passez. Add s'il vous plaît to a request or instruction. Payer par carte means paying by card.
lessons.scene: Sam asks Camille for water and the bill before paying.

cards.fr: Pourriez-vous nous apporter l'addition, s'il vous plaît ?
cards.en: Could you bring us the bill, please?

cards.fr: Pourriez-vous prendre une photo de nous ?
cards.en: Could you take a photo of us?

cards.fr: Apportez-moi un verre d'eau, s'il vous plaît.
cards.en: Bring me a glass of water, please.

cards.fr: Excusez-moi, pourriez-vous me passer le sel ?
cards.en: Excuse me, could you pass me the salt?

cards.fr: Attendez un instant, s'il vous plaît.
Est-ce que je peux payer par carte ?

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Excusez-moi, pourriez-vous me passer le sel ?
reader.en: Excuse me, could you pass me the salt?

reader.speaker: Camille
reader.fr: Bien sûr. Vous voulez aussi de l'eau ?
reader.en: Of course. Would you also like water?

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Oui. Apportez-moi un verre d'eau, s'il vous plaît.
reader.en: Yes. Bring me a glass of water, please.

reader.speaker: Camille
reader.fr: Voici l'eau. Vous désirez autre chose ?
reader.en: Here is the water. Would you like anything else?

reader.fr: Pourriez-vous prendre une photo de nous ?
reader.en: Could you take a photo of us?

reader.speaker: Camille
reader.fr: Bien sûr. Voilà la photo.
reader.en: Of course. Here is the photo.

reader.fr: Oui, vous pouvez payer par carte. Je vous apporte aussi le reçu.
reader.en: Yes, you can pay by card. I'll also bring you the receipt.

lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Words You Already Know and Getting Help
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Spot dinner cognates and use survival phrases to get help when you don't understand.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Tell the server you don't understand, ask them to repeat more slowly, and ask how to say a dish in Spanish.
lessons.title: French Cognates and Getting Help
lessons.objective: Recognize useful French dinner cognates and ask for repetition or a translation when you do not understand.
lessons.focus: French -tion words such as recommandation often resemble English -tion words; spécialité and ingrédient are also recognizable, but their French pronunciation differs. Say je ne comprends pas, pourriez-vous répéter plus lentement ?, and comment dit-on ce plat en français ? to ask for help.
lessons.scene: Sam asks Camille to repeat a dish name, then states a peanut allergy while discussing ingredients.

cards.fr: Je ne comprends pas. Pourriez-vous parler plus lentement ?
cards.en: I don't understand. Could you speak more slowly?

cards.fr: Comment dit-on ce plat en français ?
cards.en: How do you say this dish in French?

cards.fr: J'ai besoin d'aide, s'il vous plaît.

reader.speaker: Camille
reader.fr: Voici notre spécialité du soir. C'est une recommandation de la cheffe.
reader.en: Here is our evening specialty. It's a recommendation from the chef.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Je ne comprends pas. Pourriez-vous parler plus lentement ?
reader.en: I don't understand. Could you speak more slowly?

reader.speaker: Camille
reader.fr: Bien sûr. Je peux répéter le nom du plat.
reader.en: Of course. I can repeat the name of the dish.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Comment dit-on ce plat en français ?
reader.en: How do you say this dish in French?

reader.speaker: Camille
reader.fr: On dit « gratin de légumes ».
reader.en: We say “vegetable gratin.”

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Merci. Je suis allergique aux cacahuètes. Quels sont les ingrédients ?
reader.en: Thank you. I'm allergic to peanuts. What are the ingredients?

reader.speaker: Camille
reader.fr: Je vais vous donner la liste des ingrédients.
reader.en: I'll give you the ingredient list.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Merci. J'ai aussi besoin d'aide pour choisir une option.
reader.en: Thank you. I also need help choosing an option.
